requested_behavior: Keep source-attached thinking threads while removing finished threads from active channel list.
Split long replies at sentence punctuation, with whitespace fallback and lossless UTF-8-safe paging.
implementation: Completed, caught-up activity archives its source-bound Echo-owned thread when no sibling target remains active.
Further activity reopens the same thread before delivery; moderator locks are respected.
New threads use a 60-minute inactivity fallback. No thread content is deleted.
Gateway records thread ID for thread audience updates; unrelated thread updates no longer cancel turns or command jobs. Old or missing IDs retain conservative invalidation.
Chunk boundaries prefer . ? ! followed by whitespace, allowing straight closing quotes/brackets. Long sentences fall back to whitespace; an over-limit unbroken token uses a UTF-8-safe hard split.
